name: task-matrix
description: Noah's personal 3×3 task matrix with local task tools.

interface.shortDescription: Organize tasks by importance and urgency.
interface.longDescription: A private, local task board with Doing and Tracking tasks and matching Codex task tools.
interface.defaultPrompt: For any activity involving tasks, first ensure the Task Matrix web server is running at http://127.0.0.1:8765 (check http://127.0.0.1:8765/health; if it is down, start the server process with `python3 ~/plugins/task-matrix/server.py web` and keep it running). Then open http://127.0.0.1:8765/ in Codex's captive browser using the in-app browser tool, and keep the board open while reviewing or updating tasks. Use Task Matrix tools for task data.
